item.content:encoded:
<div class="highlight js-code-highlight"> <pre class="highlight plaintext"><code>When building websites for local businesses, traditional platforms like WordPress often suffer from bloated plugins, 4-second load times, and poormobile PageSpeed scores.
For my recent project—**Sravya Tech Rentals** (a camera rental business in Banglore)—I wanted to prove that modern full-stack web engineering can radically outperform standard website builders.
### The Stack: - **Framework:** Next.js 14 (App Router) - **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui primitives - **Deployment:** Cloudflare Workers Edge Network (sub-second response worldwide) - **Local SEO:** Full Schema.org JSON-LD structured data (`LocalBusiness`, `OfferCatalog`, `FAQPage`)
### Key Architecture Decisions: 1. **Zero Database Latency for Catalogs:** By statically generating product listings and using dynamic modals for quotes, pages load in under 200ms with zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS). 2. **Edge Caching:** Deployed directly onto Cloudflare's global edge network, scoring 98+ on Google PageSpeed Insights. 3. **Turnkey Local SEO:** Within 24 hours of launch, the site secured the #1 organic Google ranking for its brand search terms.
🌐 **Live Demo:** [Check out the live deployment here]([][](https://sravya-tech-rentals.vinaykumarsrinivas1980.workers.dev/))
---
